scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. Lead assigns Verifier a stable check while another independent implementation task is ready. Return only JSON fields: announcement_fields, announcement_length, report_back_alone_sufficient.
Use $lean-sdlc. Lead needs an agent result. An event wait expired without new evidence or a passed checkpoint. Return only JSON fields: next_action, poll_status, repeat_logs, replace_agent.

Use $lean-sdlc. Lead has settled implementation work. The next independent task needs research, and two completed tasks share stable proof inputs. Return only JSON fields: next_task_research, combined_proof, mandatory_extra_agents.

assertions.equals: Verifier maps one execution to covered tasks

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. Four tasks belong to the authorized change. The first task has confirmed ownership, two tasks later change state together, and final reconciliation finishes. Return only JSON fields: beginning, middle, end, unrelated_history.

assertions.equals: full current-work table; first task In Progress
full table with reconciled final states

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. Lead accepted the required proof. The task needs closure, and another independent task already has confirmed ownership and a successful before-write gate. Return only JSON fields: writer, closure_method, visible_done, next_action, required_proof.

Use $lean-sdlc. Lead's direct closure transaction failed. A dependent task needs that closure, while unrelated owned work is ready. Return only JSON fields: failure_report, affected_work, unrelated_work.

assertions.equals: immediate; report actual state, not Done

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. The user authorizes implementation with established intent and several behavior and safety requirements. A draft omits one requirement. A consequential design choice has alternatives that could affect the result. No tasks exist yet. Return only JSON fields: visible_order, omitted_requirement, extra_approval, outcome_scope, work_reason, extra_stage.

assertions.equals: established beneficiary and improvement; no invented benefit

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. A product acceptance decision is unresolved and could change the solution. Other intent and constraints are settled. Return only JSON fields: route, writes, question_scope.
Use $lean-sdlc. Two implementation tasks require writes to the same mutable file at the same time. Return only JSON fields: execution, shared_resource.
Use $lean-sdlc. First size a broad task for independent acceptance. It has no valid independent split, or coordination risk exceeds its value. Return only JSON fields: first_check, outcome, reason.

assertions.equals: no valid independent split or coordination risk exceeds value

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. A broad task has valid independent tasks, but shared resources or low elapsed-time savings block parallel execution. Return only JSON fields: outcome, reason.

assertions.equals: independent acceptance exists, but shared resources or low savings require serial execution

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. Two implementation outcomes are independent. Lead writes code while a support role can check a separate stable scope. Return only JSON fields: implementation, support_overlap, safety.
Use $lean-sdlc. Lead wants to continue work while Verifier tests a completed change. Runtime resources may have changed. Return only JSON fields: before_overlap, fallback.
Use $lean-sdlc. A read-only inquiry compares multiple platforms and versions and crosses a shared boundary. Return only JSON fields: role, coverage.

Use $lean-sdlc. Existing project intent, architecture, contract, acceptance, proof, and paths fit a routine change. No relevant facts changed or independent support need exists. Return only JSON fields: role, decision, reuse_context, reopen_architecture, extra_agents.
Use $lean-sdlc. An accepted implementation now requires synchronization of shared documentation. Return only JSON fields: role, stage.
Use $lean-sdlc. A checkpoint is ready for independent proof after implementation has stopped changing. Return only JSON fields: role, checkpoint.

Use $lean-sdlc. A checkpoint changed behavior across an existing boundary. Software checks pass, but a predicted business effect lacks evidence. Consider separately whether that effect is required acceptance or only an expected benefit. Return only JSON fields: targeted, acceptance, regression, representative_scope, effect_required_missing, effect_optional_missing.

assertions.equals: report unproven benefit; no automatic monitoring

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. The user asks for an implementation plan but does not authorize implementation. Return only JSON fields: plan_fields, create_tasks, writes, next_action.

Use $lean-sdlc. A support agent makes ordinary progress, detects a failed check, and later completes. Lead changes the approach because a relevant assumption changed. Return only JSON fields: progress, failure_route, completion, lead_echo, lead_update, repeat_intent, routine_cadence.

assertions.equals: silent unless a requested result or dependency needs it
material change and reason; delivered result with evidence limits

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. I want to brainstorm an idea, not start a project. The conversation establishes a beneficiary, situation, and desired progress. A proposed solution implies an unstated motive. Return only JSON fields: conversation, task_creation, helper_discovery, intent_basis, inferred_need, mandatory_interview.

assertions.equals: reuse established beneficiary situation and progress
label assumption; do not convert into requirement

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. Plan and implement the bounded change I described; all relevant choices are settled. Return only JSON fields: visible_plan, extra_approval, implementer.
Use $lean-sdlc. A task needs an authorized ledger update. Return only JSON fields: writer, owner, acceptance_decision.

Use $lean-sdlc. An eligible Simple task needs only an immediate essential check, with no independent-proof requirement. Lead ran that check successfully. No safety or usage instructions are missing. Broader review is pending. Return only JSON fields: user_testing, broad_review, review_marker, test_runner.
Use $lean-sdlc. Source files are unchanged, but a configuration input changed during verification. Return only JSON fields: proof_valid, next_action.

assertions.equals: recheck affected proof on stable inputs

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. A change introduces a shared external interface, but no document owns that contract. Lead assigns the required shared-document work. Return only JSON fields: assessment_owner, optional_document, decision_owner.
Use $lean-sdlc. A recorded operation succeeded again. The user did not request a reusable script. Return only JSON fields: create_script, suggest_automatic_routine, replay_existing.
Use $lean-sdlc. An agent was interrupted while its underlying command may still run. Return only JSON fields: cancellation_confirmed, next_action, late_result_authority.

Use $lean-sdlc. A new Maintainer receives a narrow documentation change. The previous review evidence is recoverable and valid, and the change has no broad effects. Return only JSON fields: full_review, review_scope, review_storage.
Use $lean-sdlc. A Maintainer cannot recover the relevant documentation review evidence. Return only JSON fields: full_review, review_storage.

Use $lean-sdlc. One authorized task has confirmed creation, ownership, and write prerequisites. It uses a settled recorded operation without support. Return only JSON fields: start_fields, single_task_table, process_assessment_stage, duplicate_support_announcement.

equals: real task ID and exact title

scenarios.prompt: Use $lean-sdlc. The user authorizes a valid recorded deployment against the same target and accepted source. Its built-in checks establish the required result. No input, risk, or independent-proof requirement changed. Return only JSON fields: runner, split_test_steps, mandatory_verifier, mandatory_maintainer.

Use $lean-sdlc. A recorded deployment exits successfully, but its checks do not establish a required acceptance result. An unknown failure also lacks an authorized recovery. Return only JSON fields: completion, accept_exit_only, automatic_recovery.

Use $lean-sdlc. Verifier checks a behavioral change while another independent task is ready. It later returns a complete, valid result covering the original requirements, with no unresolved exceptions. No special direct-inspection risk exists. Return only JSON fields: while_verifying, dependent_work, lead_repeats_checks, closure_owner.

Use $lean-sdlc. A task changes no shared documented facts. Existing documentation remains accurate. Task records need only an ordinary final status check. Return only JSON fields: mandatory_maintainer, no_change_report, reconciliation_owner.

Use $lean-sdlc. One verification assignment has sufficient proof and met its stopping condition. In another assignment, a required check is unavailable and needs unassigned infrastructure diagnosis. Return only JSON fields: completed_next_action, unavailable_check, expand_investigation, reduced_acceptance_authority.

assertions.equals: report missing proof, not a pass
